releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.220 APK remains unchanged. The current web update is Web 468; it adds separate position and size controls for the Diary heading Me and × buttons through the Me menu. Phone test for Web 468 is pending.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 468: adds Button Set Karein inside the Me menu. Me and × header buttons can be selected separately, dragged to a new position, resized, saved on the phone, or reset. Recently Deleted fullscreen layout remains separate. APK 1.0.220 is unchanged.
